_comment: Applied by build.py to every recorded answer and page. 'merge': ubus answers deep-merged with these values (the device: model, CPU, kernel, memory...). 'set': whole ubus answers ([status, data]) for what a container cannot give honestly (a radio, mounts). 'http': whole answers for other requests (the kernel log). 'replace': regex -> text over all strings (container names, the docker subnet). build.py also moves the router to 192.168.1.1 and makes DHCP leases of the named clients.
